trial_court: III Additional District and Sessions Judge, Mahabubnagar District at Gadwal (O.S.No.17 of 2014)

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Ediga Sarabhamma, daughters of Nadipi Sunkanna Goud

facts_of_case: Plaintiffs sought declaration of title and recovery of possession and damages from defendants who claimed exclusive rights over the suit schedule properties.

legal_principles.principle: A plain reading of Order VII Rule 7 makes it clear that it is primarily concerned with drafting of relief in a plaint.
legal_principles.held: It shall not be necessary to ask for general or other relief which may always be given as the Court may think just on the facts of the case to the same extent as if it has been asked for.
applicable_acts_sections: Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 — Order VII Rule 7
cited_cases: Rajendra Tiwary Vs. Basudeo Prasad and Anr., (4 supra)

legal_principles.principle: Ordinarily, the Court cannot grant relief to the plaintiff on a case for which there was no foundation in the pleadings & which the other side was not called upon or had an opportunity to meet.
legal_principles.held: But when the alternative case, which the plaintiff could have made, was not only admitted by the defendant in his written statement but was expressly put forward as an answer to the claim which the plaintiff made in the suit, there would be nothing improper in giving the plaintiff a decree upon the case which the defendant himself makes.
cited_cases: Firm Sriniwas Bam Kumar vs. Mahabir Prasad & Ors., [AIR 1951 SC 177]

legal_principles.principle: Once it is declared that the plaintiff is entitled to a share in the suit land, the necessary consequence of it is to divide the suit land and give her half share.
legal_principles.held: As all the persons entitled to a share in the suit land are parties to the suit, in a suit of this nature the relief for partition must be deemed to have been prayed for in the suit.

outcome.final_order: The trial court's judgment and decree were upheld, dismissing the plaintiffs' suit.
